bluf: Posture is Elevated because of cyber; the physical hazard picture is Normal. The exploited Brotli RCE (CVE-2026-111497, Node2Shell, CVSS 9.8) hits Node.js/.NET stacks across WashU and WashU Medicine; two lanes flagged it independently. The UNM Health ransomware attack, which diverted ambulances Oct 26, is the Medical Campus analogue. Saturday Oct 31 stacks Family Weekend, 1 PM football, the CWE Halloween party (Euclid closed to midnight) and Loop trick-or-treat. No NWS products, Ring 1 violent incidents, or health advisories. Election Day Nov 3 puts public polling inside McDonnell Medical Sciences and the Athletic Complex.
